categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Tellgen Life Science Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of IVD products. Its main product lines include tumor markers, HPV nucleic acid detection, autoimmune disease detection, methylation mutation detection, and biochemical diagnostic products. The company also develops supporting diagnostic instruments and offers clinical testing solutions across multiple disease areas such as oncology, autoimmune diseases, cardiovascular diseases, infections, and reproductive health.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including high-throughput flow fluorescence technology, chemiluminescence immunoassay, multiplex multicolor fluorescence PCR, and mass spectrometry. It operates cleanroom manufacturing facilities compliant with ISO13485:2016 standards and employs strict quality management systems. Production is organized across multiple subsidiaries with a strategic layout of manufacturing bases in Shanghai and Jiangxi, ensuring quality control and efficient supply.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tellgen's primary customers are domestic medical institutions, especially tertiary hospitals which account for approximately 69.53% of hospital clients. Other customers include physical examination centers and independent laboratories. The company also serves third-party testing clients and is expanding its presence in overseas markets including Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Russian-speaking regions. Its products are widely used in clinical diagnostics for early disease screening, diagnosis, treatment monitoring, and prognosis evaluation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering all 31 provinces and municipalities with a strong presence in key regions such as East China, North China, South China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast China. It has also established overseas subsidiaries and distribution channels in countries including Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, and Spain, aiming to expand its international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Tellgen Life Science operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain. It focuses on the development and manufacturing of diagnostic reagents and instruments, supplying these products to hospitals, laboratories, and testing centers. The company also engages in marketing, sales, and after-sales technical support, positioning itself as a comprehensive provider of IVD solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation and R&D with an annual investment of around 15% of revenue. It focuses on expanding its product portfolio in tumor markers, molecular diagnostics, autoimmune diseases, and methylation detection. Strategic priorities include developing high-throughput, automated, and multiplex detection platforms, enhancing product performance, and accelerating the commercialization of non-centralized procurement products. The company also pursues external collaborations, investments, and acquisitions to complement its product lines and strengthen its market position.
categories.revenue_model: Tellgen generates revenue primarily through the sale of IVD reagents and diagnostic instruments. The sales model combines direct sales and distributor-based sales, with a predominant reliance on distributors. The company employs an 'instrument + reagent' linked sales approach, where instruments are provided to customers with ownership retained by the company, and revenue is mainly derived from reagent sales. Service income and other minor revenue streams also contribute to total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the highly competitive IVD market, which is dominated globally by multinational corporations such as Roche, Abbott, Siemens, and Danaher. In China, Tellgen is recognized as a leading domestic player with a comprehensive product portfolio, especially in tumor marker and molecular diagnostics. It is positioned as a high-end clinical diagnostics provider with strong technological platforms and a growing market share, benefiting from the ongoing domestic substitution of imported IVD products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Shanghai Tellgen Life Science reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 436.78 million, representing a 19.53% decline year-over-year, primarily due to industry-wide centralized procurement pressures. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 34.53 million, down 61.37% from the previous year. Despite revenue contraction, the company maintains stable gross margins and has implemented cost reduction measures. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.75 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tellgen differentiates itself through its advanced technological platforms enabling high-throughput, multiplex, and automated diagnostic testing. It offers a broad and integrated product line covering the full disease screening and monitoring spectrum, particularly in oncology and autoimmune diseases. The company emphasizes product quality, innovation, and localization advantages to provide cost-effective alternatives to imported products. Its comprehensive quality management system and extensive clinical validation have earned strong recognition from leading medical institutions.
